notes.title: Memory Mode is coming!
notes.notes:
Dear players：

We have just updated the last open mode: Memory Mode. In this mode, we made a very simple exhibition hall, which included all the design draft, scrap draft and some design ideas in the development process. It is our comb of the development process. At the same time, we also put in many of our players'peer maps and made a series of still frame statues.

Update to this point, we will say goodbye to you for a short time. Anyway, we need to stay for a while to think about the future. Thank you for supporting all the time. Future update plans, we will disclose later, can be sure that we will do more content for the game to you.

Thanks for playing our game.

Best

notes.title: New Content Released!11.9
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
We released some new contents for the game. Here is the update note:
[h1]Important Update 1: New Special Mode "Bloody Tower" is available.[/h1]
1)You can enter it in special mode menu after you finished the story mode or challenge mode once.
2)You should beat the enemies by least time. Time is important!
3)You may get some items to help yourselfs. 
4)This mode will record your best score.

[h1]Important Update 2: OST DLC is available for free.[/h1]
1) As promised, the OST will be free for our players.
2) The free date lasts till next Monday.
3) Steam's music download is complex and not controlled by us, so occasionally it will encounter download failure.If so, you should try it later.

[h1]Important Update 3: Trading Cards is available[/h1]
1)The card drops every 45 minutes, and if you have played enough time, you will receive cards directly.
2)Cards are resources of Steam and are not subject to our control.

Other update:
1)Add a toggle for gamepad shaking in control setting panel.
2)Add gamepad shaking for some actions.
3)Fixed some issues about Boss Challenge mode.
4)Fixed some issues about frame rate.
5)Fixed some issues about Boss AI
6)Fixed some issues about camera shaking.
7)Fixed some issues about enemies' birth.

Thanks for your support. We will keep improving the game and will bring more new content and new gameplay. If you enjoy the game, please give us a positive review, it's important for us. Thank you. Next week, we will release the Memory Mode , in this mode , we will show you the development process, you can see the manuscripts and design idea.

notes.title: New Mode & Big Update 11.2
notes.notes:
Dear players:

[h1]Major contents 1: deeply solved the problem of performance optimization.[/h1]
1) the GTX750Ti high quality 40-50FPS.
2) the GTX960    high quality 55-65FPS.
3) the GTX1060  high quality 80-100FPS.
Our optimization update has been released for more than one day, and the feedback from the players who have experienced it has greatly improved their performance. We are very happy to see that some players can play with the core graphics card. If the performance is still insufficient, please try to adjust the quality to medium or low-end mode, or lower the resolution. We apologize once again for the awful experience we had before the performance problem.

[h1]Major content 2: BOSS challenge mode! New BOSS added[/h1]
1) After the game is cleared, players can enter the "boss challenge mode" in special mode.
2) The boss Challenge Model can directly challenge all BOSS, but please note that the AI difficulty of BOSS will be improved, especially in their second stage.
3) New BOSS! New BOSS was added: the replicant of Belvia(AI with all weapons and skills) and the original Iudex Soldier - Poetica.They are very difficult.
4) Every BOSS challenge is not only very difficult, but also has a scoring mechanism.

Other updates:
1, Improved some of the graphic, so that the graphic looks more comfortable.
2, Increased the gamepad vibration for some actions.
3, Adjust the effect of some actions to make fighting smooth and easier.
4, Adjust the shooting behavior of the bow.
5, Increased the light attack behavior of fist, can upspring the enemy.
6. Fixed some issues about the camera.
7. Fixed some issues about the air wall.
8, Fixed some issues about the description errors of the panel.
9. Fixed some issues about switching weapons in air.
10, Fixed some issues about sound effects.
11, Fixed some other minor problems.

After that, we will continue to optimize the game's problems and continue to bring new content to players. We are also going to upload the original soundtrack DLC (free download at a time limit) as a compensation to the players.
I wish you can enjoy the game. If you have a good experience, please give us a positive review, it's important for us. Thank you.

notes.title: Important Update 10.24
notes.notes:
Dear Players:

We released a big update patch. Don't worry, follow is the content:

1.Much improved the performance. Now the performance is better.
2.Improved audio system. Now audios are more fitable and less BUG. When dialogue happen, other audios' volum will be lower.
3.Improved camera for mouse.Thanks for players' suggistions, we can try more solutions.
4.Improved the performance of loading. Now loading is faster.
5.Fixed issue about the fly track when knocked fly.
6.Fixed issue about spell release by gamepad. Now if you are using gamepad and pressing R1, you can continue release spell.
7.Fixed some issues about the EX attack state.
8.Fixed issue about some enemies don't have VFX for born state.

We've been counting the feedback from players and fixing it tightly, such as performance optimization, sound effects, cameras, etc. Especially performance optimization, as a 3D ACT game, to see a large number of players who want to support us can not have smooth experience , just like a network game so that players can not connect to the server as hurtful. I feel so miserable and self-reproached that it's hard to make up for the bad experience even if I stay up all night long. I apologize to our players. At present, the optimization of the game has not been completely completed, there are still some places that drop the frame, we will further optimize, until all players can get smooth experience . To apologize, we will put the original soundtrack as a DLC free, presented to players, including five songs and 20 BGM, by Japan and the U.S.A, Kobayashi, Emi Evans and other singing star.

The plan for further to improve the game:
1.Continue to optimize, finaly we will promise all players can get smooth experience.
2.Continue to improve the audios.
3.Continue to fix bugs.
4.Improve the quality of cutscenes.

The plan for more content in further:
1.We will develop a mode for Boss challenge. Players will be able to challenge all Boss. And we will add two new Boss:  Replicant of Belvia(contains four weapons and all spells), Poetica(weapon is katana).
2.We will developo an endless mode. Players can challenge the higher socer.
3.Memory mode. We will reveal the development process, abandoned schemes, various design documents, motivations and ideas, and we will implant a large number of hidden eggs.

All the content will be free, please wait us.

Finally, it's really a shame to bring bad experiences to the players. Sorry, we'll try our best to compensate.

notes.title: Notice for Sale
notes.notes:
Dear Players:

      In fact, I'm not exciting but worrying, because our game is released. We want to improve it for more years, but our resources don't allow it. So, we decide to let it on sale.

      After our last game, we got much encourage and support.And also got much criticism.Of course , we knew we were not good enough to face players. But we have two advantage : technology of Action Game and determination of improving. So we did much for this game, to show a better game for you.
      1) We read more than one thousand reviews of our last game.
      2) We watched many videos of our last game to know how players play our game.
      3) We keep communication with players all the time.
      4) We tried some new technology  to improve our game.

      There is some special content in game marked with "coming soon". It will be updated in game soon, and it's free.

       About BUG and suggestion:  we only have 9 developers,  we really did our best to test our game. But there are still some BUG. If you find any BUG or you have any suggestion, please tell us. You can tell it by email : 495361173@qq.com

       OK, We hope our progress is good enough to show a better game to you. Thanks!
